question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.
sql:
WITH partnerships AS (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.striker, bb.non_striker, 
           SUM(b.runs_scored) as partnership_runs
    FROM batsman_scored b 
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON b.match_id = bb.match_id AND b.over_id = bb.over_id AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no 
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL AND bb.non_striker IS NOT NULL 
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.striker, bb.non_striker
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker, non_striker, partnership_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM partnerships
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, striker, non_striker, partnership_runs
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
player_scores AS (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.striker as player_id, SUM(b.runs_scored) as total_score
    FROM batsman_scored b
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON b.match_id = bb.match_id AND b.over_id = bb.over_id AND b.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker
),
ordered_pairs AS (
    SELECT tp.match_id,
           CASE 
               WHEN ps.total_score > ps2.total_score THEN tp.striker
               WHEN ps.total_score < ps2.total_score THEN tp.non_striker
               WHEN tp.striker > tp.non_striker THEN tp.striker
               ELSE tp.non_striker
           END as player1,
           CASE 
               WHEN ps.total_score > ps2.total_score THEN tp.non_striker
               WHEN ps.total_score < ps2.total_score THEN tp.striker
               WHEN tp.striker > tp.non_striker THEN tp.non_striker
               ELSE tp.striker
           END as player2,
           CASE 
               WHEN ps.total_score > ps2.total_score THEN ps.total_score
               WHEN ps.total_score < ps2.total_score THEN ps2.total_score
               WHEN tp.striker > tp.non_striker THEN ps.total_score
               ELSE ps2.total_score
           END as player1_score,
           CASE 
               WHEN ps.total_score > ps2.total_score THEN ps2.total_score
               WHEN ps.total_score < ps2.total_score THEN ps.total_score
               WHEN tp.striker > tp.non_striker THEN ps2.total_score
               ELSE ps.total_score
           END as player2_score,
           tp.partnership_runs
    FROM top_partnerships tp
    LEFT JOIN player_scores ps ON tp.match_id = ps.match_id AND tp.striker = ps.player_id
    LEFT JOIN player_scores ps2 ON tp.match_id = ps2.match_id AND tp.non_striker = ps2.player_id
    WHERE tp.striker = ps.player_id AND tp.non_striker = ps2.player_id
)

FROM ordered_pairs
